# Milestone brief — source-truth-m2

**Title:** Chunks schema v2: spans, truncation, printed numbers persisted
**Kind:** milestone
**Roadmap:** source-truth (plans/source-truth/roadmap.yaml)
**Status:** planned
**Lane:** next
**Target:** 2026-08-04 -> 2026-08-21

## Parent epic

- source-truth-e2 — Chunk-level source truth: spans, truncation, printed numbers
  Chunks-schema v2 rides ingest/store.py::_migrate_chunks_schema_if_needed with five columns (source_revision_id, source_span, truncated, printed_number, license_ref), the printed-number extractor, span anchoring computed from the existing parsed HTML (null-plus-reported fallback, no re-parse), and zero-re-embed backfill per the tools/notebook_metadata_backfill.py precedent. Vertical to the serving surface: get_chunk responses carry revision id, span-or-null, truncation status, and printed number, with field surfacing batched into agent-platform's W1 tool-schema window.

## Summary

Five new columns (source_revision_id, source_span, truncated, printed_number, license_ref) ride the shipped add-columns migration; the printed-number extractor and the span-anchoring pass run over the existing parsed HTML (no re-parse; un-anchorable blocks keep source_span null and are reported); backfill hydrates both live notebooks with 0 chunks re-embedded per the tools/notebook_metadata_backfill.py precedent.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Given the live LanceDB chunks table, when the v2 migration runs, then the five source-truth columns exist, existing rows are preserved, and a second run is a no-op
2. Given both live notebooks, when the source-truth backfill completes, then truncation status, printed numbers, span anchors, source_revision_id, and license_ref are hydrated with 0 chunks re-embedded
3. Given a block that cannot be re-anchored from the existing parsed HTML, when the backfill completes, then its source_span is null and it is counted in an abstention report (abstention, not silence)

## Depends on

- source-truth-m1 — Revision registry live with license provenance (advisory) [status: planned]
- source-truth-spike-2 — Printed-number extraction coverage on 20 Bridgeland papers [status: planned]
- source-truth-spike-3 — Span-anchor stability across LaTeXML re-parses [status: planned]
- source-truth-spike-4 — Chunks-schema v2 migration dry-run on a LanceDB snapshot [status: planned]
